about: OCR fixes for NoodLeverage.pdf. Every entry was checked against the rendered page image (3x PDFKit render) before being added; the narration was used only to find candidates, never as the source of truth. 'find' matches a whole word (surrounding punctuation is kept); 'context' (optional) must appear within the surrounding words; 'page' (optional) limits the fix to one page. 'token': true requires the whole token to equal 'find'.

fixes.note: Inter's capital I read as lowercase l; page shows AI (all occurrences, e.g. 'AI systems', '(AI).')
standalone lowercase l is the pronoun I on the page ('once I', 'know I')
page: 'mindset I moved to Fort Worth'
page: 'note that I define steps well'
page: 'as hard as I worked on'
page: 'on the day I run out'
page has a space: 'complexity" to turn chaos'
page closes the quote with a double quote: 'PRI"),'
no stray apostrophe on the page: 'to go?" on page 3'
page shows three commas: '"Seriously,,, during the day'
